description: PRD-42: Plugin Marketplace & Agent Personas — Admin-curated plugin marketplace with S3 storage, LLM security scanning, workspace enablement, agent plugin assignment, and database-backed agent persona system.

userStories.title: Create plugin marketplace database models
userStories.description: As a developer, I need SQLAlchemy ORM models for the plugin marketplace so the system can store plugin metadata, categories, and security scan results.
acceptanceCriteria: Create orchestrator/core/models/marketplace_plugins.py with all marketplace models
PluginCategory SQLAlchemy model: id (UUID PK), slug (unique, varchar 50), name (varchar 100), description (text), icon (varchar 50), sort_order (int default 0), parent_id (FK self-ref), created_at

MarketplacePlugin SQLAlchemy model: id (UUID PK), slug (unique, varchar 100), name, version, s3_bucket (default 'automatos-marketplace'), s3_path, description, long_description, category_id (FK), tags (ARRAY), skills_count, commands_count, agents_count, hooks_count, source_type, source_url, source_repo, original_author, license, token_estimate, recommended_models (ARRAY), security_scan_id (FK), security_status (default 'pending'), is_active, is_featured, approval_status (default 'pending'), approved_by, approved_at, rejection_reason, enable_count, created_at, updated_at

PluginSecurityScan SQLAlchemy model: id (UUID PK), plugin_slug, plugin_version, static_scan_status, static_findings (JSONB), blocked_patterns_found (ARRAY), llm_scan_status, llm_risk_score, llm_findings (JSONB), llm_summary, llm_model_used, llm_tokens_used, overall_verdict, scanned_at, scanned_by
PluginSyncHistory SQLAlchemy model: id (UUID PK), action, plugin_id (FK), plugin_slug, status, started_at, completed_at, details (JSONB), error_message, performed_by
All models use extend_existing=True pattern matching existing codebase
Models imported and registered in orchestrator/core/models/__init__.py
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Follow patterns from core.py — use Column, mapped_column, UUID PK with gen_random_uuid default

userStories.title: Create workspace and agent plugin junction models
userStories.description: As a developer, I need junction table models for workspace plugin enablement and agent plugin assignment.
acceptanceCriteria: Add to orchestrator/core/models/marketplace_plugins.py (or separate file if cleaner)

WorkspaceEnabledPlugin model: workspace_id (UUID FK workspaces, cascade), plugin_id (UUID FK marketplace_plugins, cascade), enabled_at, enabled_by (UUID FK users). Composite PK (workspace_id, plugin_id)
AgentAssignedPlugin model: agent_id (UUID FK agents, cascade), plugin_id (UUID FK marketplace_plugins, cascade), priority (int default 0), assigned_at. Composite PK (agent_id, plugin_id)

Add appropriate indexes: workspace_id on workspace_enabled_plugins, agent_id on agent_assigned_plugins, category_id on marketplace_plugins, (approval_status, is_active) on marketplace_plugins, (is_featured, enable_count DESC) on marketplace_plugins
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Junction tables use composite primary keys. Follow pattern of agent_skills association table in core.py

userStories.title: Create persona database model and agent columns
userStories.description: As a developer, I need the personas table and agent persona columns so agents can adopt personality profiles.
acceptanceCriteria: Create orchestrator/core/models/personas.py with Persona SQLAlchemy model

Persona model: id (UUID PK), slug (unique varchar 100), name (varchar 255), description (text), system_prompt (text), voice_description (varchar 500), category (varchar 100), tags (ARRAY), suggested_temperature (float default 0.7), suggested_models (ARRAY), source (varchar 100), source_url (varchar 500), scope (varchar 20, default 'global'), workspace_id (UUID FK workspaces, nullable), is_active (bool default true), created_at, updated_at
Add persona columns to Agent model in core.py: persona_id (UUID FK personas, nullable), custom_persona_prompt (Text, nullable), use_custom_persona (Boolean, default false)
Add indexes: idx_personas_scope (scope, workspace_id), idx_personas_category (category), idx_agents_persona (persona_id)
Register Persona model in models/__init__.py
Typecheck passes

acceptanceCriteria: Create orchestrator/core/services/marketplace_s3.py with MarketplaceS3Service class
Constructor reads AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID, AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY, AWS_REGION, MARKETPLACE_S3_BUCKET from config/env
upload_zip(slug, version, zip_bytes) method — uploads to _uploads/pending/{upload_id}.zip
extract_plugin(slug, version, zip_bytes) method — extracts zip to plugins/{slug}/{version}/ in S3, uploads each file individually

userStories.title: Build static security scanner
userStories.description: As the system, I need a static analysis scanner that checks plugin files for dangerous code patterns and prompt injections using regex.
acceptanceCriteria: Create orchestrator/core/services/plugin_security_scanner.py

Define pattern lists: BLOCKED_CODE_PATTERNS (import/exec/subprocess), BLOCKED_NETWORK_PATTERNS (requests/urllib/socket), BLOCKED_FS_PATTERNS (file write/delete), PROMPT_INJECTION_PATTERNS (ignore instructions, jailbreak, system prompt override, exfiltrate, hidden instruction)
StaticScanResult Pydantic model: status (passed/flagged), findings (list of dicts with type, severity, file, line, pattern, matched_text, description)
async static_scan(plugin_files: dict[str, str]) -> StaticScanResult function
Scans all text files for all pattern categories with re.IGNORECASE
Each finding includes: file path, line number, matched pattern, severity (critical/high/medium/low), finding type category
Returns 'passed' if no findings, 'flagged' otherwise
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: This is Stage 1 of the two-stage scan. Fast and free, runs before LLM scan.

userStories.title: Build LLM security scanner (Claude Haiku)
userStories.description: As the system, I need an LLM-based deep security scanner that uses Claude Haiku to detect obfuscated attacks and subtle prompt injections.
acceptanceCriteria: Add to orchestrator/core/services/plugin_security_scanner.py

LLMScanResult Pydantic model: status (passed/flagged/failed), risk_score (int 0-100), findings (list of dicts with category, severity, description, file, evidence), summary (str), model_used (str), tokens_used (int)

Define LLM_SECURITY_SCAN_PROMPT constant with detailed instructions for security audit (check for malicious code, prompt injection, data exfiltration, privilege escalation, social engineering, obfuscated code)
async llm_security_scan(plugin_files: dict[str, str], model: str = 'claude-haiku-4-20250414') -> LLMScanResult function
Concatenates all plugin files with file path headers
Calls Anthropic API (use existing ANTHROPIC_API_KEY from config) with the security prompt
Parses JSON response for risk_score, findings, summary
Returns status='passed' if risk_score < 20, 'flagged' otherwise
Handles API errors gracefully (returns failed status on error)
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Stage 2 of two-stage scan. Cost ~$0.001 per scan.

userStories.title: Build combined scan orchestrator and scan service
userStories.description: As a developer, I need a combined scan service that runs both static and LLM scans and stores results in the database.
acceptanceCriteria: Add PluginScanService class to plugin_security_scanner.py (or new file plugin_scan_service.py)
Constructor takes db session
async scan_plugin(plugin_slug, plugin_version, plugin_files: dict[str, str], scanned_by: str) -> PluginSecurityScan method
Runs static_scan first — if any critical findings, auto-block (set overall_verdict='blocked')
If static scan passes or only has warnings, run llm_security_scan
Determine overall_verdict: risk_score 0-19 = 'safe', 20-69 = 'review_required', 70+ = 'blocked'
Create PluginSecurityScan database record with all results
Return the created PluginSecurityScan record
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Orchestrates Stage 1 + Stage 2 and persists results

userStories.title: Build plugin upload and processing service
userStories.description: As a developer, I need a service that handles the full plugin upload flow: validate manifest, extract to S3, run security scans, and create database records.
acceptanceCriteria: Create orchestrator/core/services/plugin_upload_service.py with PluginUploadService class
Constructor takes db session, MarketplaceS3Service, PluginScanService
async upload_plugin(zip_bytes: bytes, source_type: str, source_url: Optional[str], uploaded_by: str) -> MarketplacePlugin method
Extract zip to temp directory, validate manifest.json exists at root
Parse manifest to extract slug, name, version, description, contents counts (skills, commands, agents, hooks)
Read all text files into dict[filepath, content] for scanning
Run PluginScanService.scan_plugin() with extracted files
Upload to S3 via MarketplaceS3Service.extract_plugin()
Create MarketplacePlugin database record with all metadata, s3_path, security_scan_id, security_status from scan verdict
Create PluginSyncHistory record with action='upload'
Return the created MarketplacePlugin
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: This is the main orchestrator for the admin upload flow

userStories.title: Build admin plugin API endpoints (upload, approve, reject)
userStories.description: As an admin, I need API endpoints to upload plugins, approve/reject them, and view scan results.
acceptanceCriteria: Create orchestrator/api/admin_plugins.py with FastAPI router (prefix=/api/admin/plugins, tags=['Admin Plugins'])

POST /api/admin/plugins/upload — accepts multipart/form-data with file (UploadFile), source_type (str), source_url (Optional[str]). Calls PluginUploadService. Returns 202 with plugin_id, scan_id, status='scanning'. Auth required via get_request_context_hybrid.
POST /api/admin/plugins/{plugin_id}/approve — sets approval_status='approved', approved_by, approved_at. Creates PluginSyncHistory record. Auth required.
POST /api/admin/plugins/{plugin_id}/reject — sets approval_status='rejected', rejection_reason from body. Creates PluginSyncHistory record. Auth required.
GET /api/admin/plugins/{plugin_id}/scan — returns security scan results (static + LLM). Auth required.
POST /api/admin/plugins/{plugin_id}/deactivate — sets is_active=False. Auth required.
GET /api/admin/plugins/pending — list plugins with approval_status='pending'. Paginated. Auth required.
Register router in orchestrator/main.py
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Admin-only endpoints. Follow existing auth patterns from marketplace.py

GET /api/marketplace/plugins/{plugin_id}/content — full plugin content (skills text, commands text) loaded from S3. Used by AgentFactory. Auth required.

userStories.title: Build workspace plugin enablement API endpoints

POST /api/workspaces/{workspace_id}/plugins — enable a plugin (body: plugin_id UUID). Creates WorkspaceEnabledPlugin junction record. Increments MarketplacePlugin.enable_count. Auth required.
